description: Build a versioned, jurisdiction-specific requirements and test plan from primary current authorities; never guess localization modules or file/submit returns.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned source subtree copied verbatim; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json

routing.when_to_use: Use when preparing requirements for country-specific Odoo accounting/tax localization, fiscal positions, e-invoicing or reporting for a named entity and deployed version.
when_not_to_use: A different atomic task has its own skill
Requested output is an unapproved action or external effect
exclusion_rules: No system mutation or external communication
ambiguity_rules: Continue unaffected work and request only facts that materially change the result

required_inputs.name: scope_and_source_inputs
required_inputs.description: entity legal location and establishments; jurisdictions/tax registrations; deployed Odoo exact version/edition; installed localization modules; transaction types/counterparties; applicable official tax/e-invoice/report specifications and dates; approved CoA/tax map; acceptance criteria.

expected_outputs.name: task_work_product
expected_outputs.description: jurisdiction matrix, source citations, candidate module/features verified against current official Odoo docs, required settings/data, test scenarios, unresolved accounting/legal decisions and Eric handoff.

forbidden_actions: Mutation of company, fund, Odoo, accounting, payroll or source records
Payments, filings, signatures, publications, messages, approvals, trades or transaction commitments
Inventing current law, jurisdiction, entity/fund applicability or missing facts
verification_steps: 1. Confirm entity, establishment, registration, transaction and reporting jurisdiction, effective date, Odoo version/edition and hosting. Unknown country or version blocks module-specific claims only. 2. Gather primary current tax authority and official Odoo version documentation for each requirement; record publication/effective dates. Treat copied country tables/examples as historical leads, not authority. 3. Map each obligation to source rule, business transaction, tax/account code, fiscal position/e-invoice/report output, required data, module/dependency and responsible owner. 4. Verify module names and functionality against official docs for the exact installed version; distinguish standard feature, add-on, custom work and unknown. Do not instruct installation or assume version compatibility. 5. Specify positive/negative acceptance tests with synthetic data: domestic, cross-border, exempt/zero-rated if applicable, credit note, validation failure, and reconciliation to accounting output. Jurisdiction branches only when applicability is evidenced. 6. Reconcile report/e-invoice output fields and totals to source invoice/ledger; define how failed submissions/rejections are surfaced, but do not submit. 7. Mark accountant/counsel decisions and unresolved jurisdiction interpretation; hand off technical changes to Eric. No credential/certificate access, install, config mutation, invoice transmission or filing.
Show formulas/denominators, evidence dates and assumptions; preserve unresolved conflicts.
Write only a requested private draft; no external effects.
completion_criteria: Conditional task scope is evidenced or limitations explicitly bound
Task method and calculation are reproducible from cited inputs
Owner decisions, open issues and source limitations are explicit

telemetry.retention_policy: opaque task/source IDs and hashes only
